notes.title: Major Update Notice - Added Mutant Flame Card
notes.content:
Respected Players of "Game of Fate 2",

The new version 0.0.9 has introduced the Mutant Flame Card. Please update your client to version 0.0.9 as soon as possible after the new version is released. We will launch an event on March 18th at 10:00 AM, during which you will have a chance to obtain the Mutant Flame Card.

If you continue to use an older version after the event starts, you may encounter errors when claiming chests, resulting in failure to receive them successfully.
Thank you for your understanding and support!

Friendly Reminder: Restarting Steam can quickly fetch the update.

Attachment: Probability table for obtaining the Mutant Flame Card is provided below.

notes.title: Free Demo Launch Event Start！
notes.content:
Hello everyone, here is the development team of "GAME of FATE 2: A CENTURY'S PROMISE", and we would like to say hello to you all. Please accept our sincerest wishes!

The free Demo of "GAME of FATE 2: A CENTURY'S PROMISE" will be available on December 27
We carefully present this special event launched simultaneously with the demo. Don't miss it if you pass by~
💋DEMO Event Announcement💋
Event period：December 27th, 2024（after Demo launched）~  23:59 January 9, 2025
Winners announced：January 10th, 2025

1: How to participate :
1.  Add the official version of "GAME of FATE 2: A CENTURY'S PROMISE" to your wishlist and Follow.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45280261/1b399e23bea84eeec256d8701dc2cdb2a2389c90.gif
2.Fill out the form and upload the above screenshot and leave your contact information👉
https://forms.gle/4EtfB74SbyYQiKjy5
2.Event Rewards :
15 players who participated in the event will be randomly selected from the registration form and given a official version of the game CDKey or a photo pack (the winning player chooses by himself, This is limited to shipping within China only. )

Precautions :
- The winning notification will be sent to the QQ account you submitted in the form.
- The rewards will be distributed in order after the full version is launched.
- If the personal information entered in the form is incorrect and causes the loss of the prize, no compensation will be given
-For more details, please check the instructions in the form

[Demo Content Related]
*The following functions and contents are locked in the demo version. If you are interested, you can experience them in the subsequent full version.
in the Demo, you can experience the first chapter of the game. The official version includes 8 main chapters, 50+ endings, and 50+ achievements
The ranking list and Tarot system are locked for now.
Chapter 1 progress rewards are temporarily unavailable。

Thank you all for your support and patience. You are our biggest motivation to move forward! Welcome to join our QQ chat group: 686270225. Your feedback and suggestions are our most valuable assets.
